caption:
He failed his 12th-grade board exam. He drove a tempo to fund his UPSC studies. He failed the exam itself three more times.

Manoj Kumar Sharma was born into a poor farming family in Bilgaon, Madhya Pradesh and failed his 12th-standard board exam, scraping through only on his second attempt. To fund his UPSC preparation he worked as a tempo driver and a library assistant in Delhi, studying between shifts with no coaching and no financial safety net. A turning point came when a newly posted DSP caught him attempting to cheat in an exam and mentored him toward honest effort instead of punishing him. He failed the UPSC exam three times before finally clearing it on his fourth attempt with All India Rank 121, joining the Indian Police Service in 2005. His story was documented in the book 'Twelfth Fail' and adapted into the acclaimed 2023 film '12th Fail,' bringing national attention to how extreme poverty and repeated failure can be overcome through persistence.
